confidence_notes: I ran three web searches: one for the RBA rate and two for Penang food and drink prices. The restaurant meal, beer and cappuccino anchors rest on crowd-sourced cost-of-living indexes (Numbeo, Citycost, MyLifeElsewhere). Those gave roughly RM15 for an inexpensive meal, RM10-17 for a draft beer, RM9-15 for a cappuccino and about RM80 for a mid-range dinner for two. I converted these at an assumed rate of about RM4.2 per USD. I did not search for a current MYR rate. Cocktail and wine anchors come from scattered venue listings and the local relationship to beer: cocktails roughly 2.5x beer, wine about RM21-28 per glass. Both are less certain, and the cocktail listings did not state their currency. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of George Town. I did not search for accommodation prices or inspect any booking pages or listings. Hawker meals can be much cheaper than the inexpensive-restaurant anchor, and hotel or rooftop bars cost more.
comparable_city_reasoning: Penang (George Town) is priced as a mid-tier Malaysian tourist city. It is similar to the Malaysian average, a bit cheaper than Kuala Lumpur for accommodation, and somewhat cheaper than Bangkok for drinks, which carry Malaysian alcohol taxes.
